contributionMap.claim: The natural universal reading of the Izgin–Kopecz–Meister–Schilling conjecture (MPRK schemes with nonnegative Runge–Kutta coefficients are globally linearly stable) is false: MPRK22(4/7) has a certified attracting two-cycle on a stiff two-species linear system whose steady state is the unique positive fixed point and locally stable.

limitationTriage.limitation: The conjecture is stated in words; the refuted universal statement is the paper's formalisation.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is the formalisation faithful to the source's own description of global stability?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Quoted the source's Section 1 description and the abstract sentence; Definition 1 uses positive initial values only (weaker than the source), so the counterexample is if anything stronger; reviewed by re-review and adversarial review.

limitationTriage.limitation: Closed-form thresholds p0(alpha), K0(alpha) in Theorem 9 are not given.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can the asymptotic expansions be made explicit with error bounds?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Explicit certified parameter sets were obtained instead (Theorems 10-11, C4, C6).
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Requires new quantitative asymptotic analysis beyond the scope of this candidate.

limitationTriage.limitation: No sharp failure region in (alpha, p, K); necessity of asymmetry and large steps is not proved.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is there a proof that p near 1/2 or moderate K excludes two-cycles?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Exploratory phase diagram (X1) and random-network scans (X2); the alpha = 1/2 and alpha = 1 theorems cover two members.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Open research question; stated as such in the paper.

limitationTriage.limitation: Global convergence of MPRK22(1/2) for three or more species, and Conjecture 17(b) for MPRK22(1) in all dimensions.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does the two-species Lyapunov argument extend to N >= 3?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Numerical monotonicity checks of candidate Lyapunov functions; Hilbert projective distance not monotone in all cases.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: A different argument is needed; stated as open problems.

limitationTriage.limitation: Conjecture 17(a) for alpha in [1/phi, 1) and alpha > 1.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can the alpha = 1 Lyapunov argument be adapted?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Log-odds distance tested numerically; not monotone for alpha in [1/phi, 1).
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Requires new ideas; stated as a refined conjecture.

limitationTriage.limitation: Uniqueness of the positive fixed point of MPRK43II(37/50) is not claimed.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can a certificate exclude other fixed points on (0,1)?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Theorem 13 does not need it; not attempted.
limitationTriage.estimatedCost: several hours of verifier development and review
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Not needed for the counterexample; would require a new certified root exclusion with fresh review.

limitationTriage.limitation: Certificates are Python programs, not proof-assistant proofs; no replay in an independent interval library (Arb, MPFI).
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Would an independent implementation reproduce C1-C2?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: AI re-review recomputed the C2 phase portrait and C3 traps with separate mpmath interval code; CI replays on Ubuntu with Python 3.10 and 3.13.
limitationTriage.estimatedCost: about a day for an Arb port
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Listed as the first next project; independent replay by another party is the appropriate route.

limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Exploratory dimerisation and other-scheme tests (X4, X5).
